kursi.1: Raka duduk di kursi belakang. Kepala bersandar ke jendela.
kursi.2: Paling tidak, sore ini sudah di rumah.

jendela.1: Sawah lewat pelan di luar. Bukit kecil menutup cakrawala.
jendela.2: Dari kota, desa kelihatan cuma titik.
jendela.3: Bus berhenti sebentar di tikungan, lalu jalan lagi.

lagu.1: Earphone masih nempel. Ganti lagu dulu.

a.1: Gitar pelan keluar dari earphone. Trek petang.

b.1: Trek hujan kecil. Bunyi tetes di latar.

c.1: Trek jalan pulang. Irama sedang, tanpa suara.

chat.1: Raka membuka chat Bang Dimas. Hari terakhir kirim pesan seminggu lalu.

santai.1: Bang, aku pulang hari ini. Sampai sore. Jemput gak usah, aku naik angkot.
santai.2: Pesan terkirim. Nada santai, seperti biasa.

singkat.1: Bang, aku sore ini pulang. Gak usah jemput.

cemas.1: Bang, kau di mana? Aku pulang hari ini. Balas ya.
cemas.2: Pesan terkirim. Raka menunggu balasan yang tidak datang.

akhir.2: Sibuk kali ya. Atau HP-nya lowbat.

flashback.1: Di saku ada foto lama. Halaman rumah, dua anak berlari.
flashback.3: Warna foto memudar. Suara tertinggal di sana.
flashback.4: Dulu kita berempat di halaman itu.

sopir.1: Raka menoleh ke depan. Sopir itu menatap kaca spion.
sopir.2: Matanya bertemu sebentar, lalu kembali ke jalan.
sopir.3: Orang desa memang begitu. Kenal tanpa pernah bicara.

turun.1: Bus berhenti di terminal. Di dalam terminal, lampu sudah menyala.

pergi.1: Turun dulu. Rumah tinggal jalan kaki lima menit.

tunggu.1: Belum kirim pesan ke Bang. Nanti dia mikir aku cuek.

obj.jalan: Sit down, look out, set the earphone
obj.tiba: Get ready to leave at the terminal

kursi.1: Raka sits in the back seat. His head rests against the window.
kursi.2: At least I will be home by this evening.

jendela.1: Fields slide past outside. A small hill blocks the horizon.
jendela.2: From the city, the village is just a dot.
jendela.3: The bus stops briefly at the bend, then moves on.

lagu.1: The earphone is still in. Change the track first.

a.1: Soft guitar comes from the earphone. The evening track.

b.1: The small rain track. Drops ticking in the back.
b.2: The city often rains like this too.

c.1: The way home track. Medium rhythm, no voices.
c.2: Anything. As long as my ears are filled.

chat.1: Raka opens Bang Dimas's chat. The last message was a week ago.
chat.2: What kind of message would feel right?

santai.1: Bang, I am coming home today. By this evening. No need to pick me up, I will take a minibus.
santai.2: Message sent. Relaxed tone, as usual.

singkat.1: Bang, heading home this afternoon. No need to pick me up.

cemas.1: Bang, where are you now? I am coming home today. Reply, okay.
cemas.2: Message sent. Raka waits for an answer that does not come.

akhir.2: Maybe he is busy. Or his battery is low.

flashback.1: An old photo in his pocket. The front yard, two kids running.
flashback.3: The colors of the photo fade. The voices stay there.
flashback.4: The four of us used to be in that yard.

sopir.1: Raka looks to the front. The driver watches the mirror.
sopir.2: Their eyes meet for a moment, then return to the road.
sopir.3: Village people are like that. They know you without ever speaking.

turun.1: The bus stops at the terminal. Inside the terminal, the lights are already on.
turun.cpergi: Get off and take the bag

pergi.1: Time to get off. Home is only a five minute walk.

tunggu.1: I never sent the message to Bang. He will think I do not care.
